Job Title: Fitter
Salary range: $79,500 - $85,000 + Superannuation – depending on skill level.
Job Closure date:3 0 days

About our client:
Our client, a renowned leader in the automotive repair industry with over three decades of excellence, is seeking a dedicated and meticulous Fitter to join their dynamic team. Renowned for their commitment to precision and restoring vehicles to their pre-accident condition, they operate from a state-of-the-art facility. If you have a passion for automotive craftsmanship and a keen eye for detail, this is your opportunity to contribute to a business that sets the industry standard.

About the Role:
In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for the hands-on structural and panel fitting that forms the foundation of every vehicle restoration. You will work on a variety of vehicles, utilizing advanced equipment and techniques to ensure every repair meets rigorous safety and quality standards. This position is perfect for a technician who takes pride in their work and understands that a perfect fit is the first step to a flawless finish.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
Vehicle Structure & Frame Analysis:
• Conduct comprehensive inspections of vehicle collision damage to assess structural integrity and identify misalignments in frames, unibody structures, and suspension mounting points.
• Utilize advanced frame straightening equipment and hydraulic systems to meticulously pull and correct structural damage back to the manufacturer’s original specifications.
• Diagnose and perform precise repairs on a vehicle's underlying structure, ensuring its safety and performance are fully restored.

Precision Panel Fitting & Alignment:
• Expertly install, align, and fit a wide range of metal panels, frames, and subassemblies—including doors, fenders, quarter panels, and bumpers—to achieve perfect contours and structural integrity.
• Meticulously adjust all replacement parts to ensure consistent, manufacturer-specified gaps and flushness across the entire vehicle body.
• Modify or custom-fabricate replacement body panels through skilled cutting, grinding, bending, and welding of sheet metal to perfectly match the vehicle's original contours.

Technical Interpretation & Mechanical Fitting:
• Interpret complex technical specifications, detailed vehicle blueprints, and comprehensive collision repair guides to determine the correct materials, tools, and sequences for each unique repair task.
• Perform the fitting and installation of mechanical components such as exhaust systems, fuel lines, and associated brackets, ensuring all parts are securely mounted and functionally sound.

Quality Control & Surface Preparation:
• Employ precision measuring instruments including callipers, micrometres, and specialised alignment tools to verify the accuracy of gaps, contours, and dimensions on all repaired or replaced body parts.
• Prepare vehicle surfaces for refinishing by undertaking skilled sanding, application of body fillers, and priming to create a perfectly smooth substrate, ready for painting.
Equipment Operation & Maintenance:
• Configure and operate a range of specialised workshop machinery, including MIG/MAG welding equipment, frame straighteners, and pneumatic/hydraulic tools, tailoring their settings for specific repair applications.

The Ideal Candidate Will Have:
• A proven track record as a Vehicle Fitter, Panel Beater, or in a similar role within the automotive repair industry.
• Formal qualifications in Automotive Body Repair, Metal Fabrication, or a related trade are highly regarded.
• Proficiency in reading and interpreting technical drawings and repair procedures.
• Demonstrated, hands-on experience with welding, metal fabrication, and the use of precision measuring tools.
• Strong mechanical aptitude and a meticulous approach to every task, with an unwavering commitment to quality.
• The ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a cohesive team in a fast-paced environment.
• A strong commitment to adhering to all workplace health and safety guidelines.

If you are a skilled Fitter ready to take on a rewarding role with a company that values quality and expertise, we encourage you to apply.

Please note: We are acting as recruitment agents on behalf of our client. Employer details will be provided to shortlisted candidates.

Full-time Estimator position available with a competitive salary. Work in a dynamic team in Berkshire Park, NSW 2765. Apply today through 11 Recruitment!

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Full-Time Estimator
•	$79,000 – $95,000 p.a. plus superannuation
•	Work in a professional environment.

Position Overview:
Ebcon is an Australian-owned construction, civil works and maintenance company delivering infrastructure, road maintenance, restoration, and electrical works projects for councils, government agencies and commercial clients. The company is recognised for its commitment to quality workmanship, safety, compliance and reliable project delivery.

As an Estimator at Ebcon, you will be responsible for preparing accurate cost estimates and tender submissions for a diverse range of civil construction and infrastructure projects. This position requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail and the ability to work collaboratively with project teams.

Responsibilities and Tasks:

•	Evaluate and interpret civil engineering, infrastructure and construction drawings, specifications and contract documentation to prepare accurate cost estimates for infrastructure, road maintenance, restoration and electrical works projects.
•	Conduct quantity take-offs and prepare detailed cost estimates using industry-standard estimating software.
•	Prepare detailed cost estimates, tender submissions, feasibility assessments and pricing proposals for civil construction, maintenance and infrastructure projects.
•	Liaise with subcontractors, suppliers and service providers to obtain competitive quotations for labour, materials, plant and specialised services.
•	Analyse project risks, cost variations and scope changes, preparing updated estimates and forecasts throughout the tender and project lifecycle.
•	Review project specifications, site conditions and client requirements to identify cost-saving opportunities while maintaining quality, safety and compliance standards.
•	Collaborate with project managers, engineers and operational teams to develop practical estimating solutions that support successful delivery of infrastructure and maintenance projects.
•	Maintain accurate estimating records, cost databases and tender documentation, ensuring submissions comply with council, government agency and commercial client requirements.

Qualifications and Skills:

•	Relevant qualification.
•	Minimum 1 year experience as an Estimator.
•	Strong understanding of civil construction methodologies, materials and cost structures.
•	Proficiency with estimating software and Microsoft Office Suite.
•	Excellent analytical, numerical and communication skills.
•	Ability to manage multiple tenders and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Salary:
The role offers a remuneration package ranging from $79,000 – $95,000 p.a. plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

How to Apply:
11 Recruitment is your pathway to securing this exciting opportunity. We are looking forward to facilitating your application and potentially welcoming you to a company that values expertise. Apply now and let us help you take the next step in your career.

About our Organisation 
VENTORA is the name behind iconic Australian brands including A&L Windows & Doors, Breezway louvres, Corinthian Doors, Stegbar Windows & Doors and Trend Windows & Doors.
As an established manufacturer with over 4,500 employees, our vision is to inspire our customers through leading brands, great service, innovative new products and solutions leveraging the full VENTORA portfolio, while significantly enhancing our ease of doing business built on operational excellence.

About the Opportunity
We are currently seeking an experienced Operational Excellence & COPQ (Cost Of Poor Quality) Transformation Specialist to join our committed team.
Reporting directly to our Chief Transformation Officer and indirectly to our Chief Manufacturing Officer, you will be responsible for driving operational excellence across all VENTORA Group manufacturing sites. Your focus will be accelerating the reduction of COPQ, supporting Transformation projects and preparing sites for scalable growth. This role is key in ensuring the readiness of Red List sites and ensuring that manufacturing processes are optimized to support business growth targets, including a 2x increase in in capacity.
Responsibilities include:
•	Drive COPQ Reduction Across Sites: Lead initiatives to identify, address, and reduce COPQ at each manufacturing site, fast-tracking reduction actions.
•	Support Transformation Projects: Provide operational support for the successful execution of Transformation Projects, aiming to modernize manufacturing processes and systems.
•	Red List Site Support: Work directly with Red List sites to build operational foundations and enhance manufacturing readiness for growth, ensuring these sites meet operational standards.
•	Enhance Manufacturing Efficiency: Identify and implement process improvements that reduce downtime, improve throughput, and optimize resource utilization across sites.
•	Leadership Support: Assist site leaders in improving operational performance, driving COPQ reduction, and supporting data-driven decision-making to foster a culture of continuous improvement. 
•	Operational Systems and Process Standardization: Work closely with local Operational Managers to develop and standardize operational systems, quality control, and inventory management processes across all sites.
•	Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with various departments to ensure alignment and successful execution of operational goals, focusing on operational excellence, cost-saving initiatives, and continuous improvement.

About You
You will bring the following skills and experience:
•	Manufacturing Leadership: Extensive senior operational management experience with a track record of improving plant operations, driving site performance, driving manufacturing excellence and achieving performance targets in a multi-site environment. 
•	COPQ Expertise: Proven track record in reducing COPQ and implementing strategies to improve product quality and profitability across manufacturing sites.
•	Operational Excellence: Deep knowledge of lean manufacturing, process optimization, and cost-saving initiatives to enhance operational performance.
•	Cross-functional Collaboration: Ability to work effectively across functions to drive transformation projects and foster a collaborative, high-performance culture.
•	People Development: Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop operational leaders and foster a culture of continuous improvement.
•	Results-Oriented: A focus on achieving measurable results and driving continuous improvement across all operational areas.
•	Time Management: Effective time management and organizational skills to prioritize tasks, manage workloads, and ensure deadlines are met.
•	Innovation: Ability to think outside the box and implement innovative solutions to improve manufacturing processes and drive operational excellence.
•	Adaptability: Ability to manage change and navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.
•	Driver’s License: Hold a current unrestricted driver’s license to perform the requirements of the role.
•	Educational Qualification: A diploma or degree in a relevant discipline (business, engineering, manufacturing) or equivalent experience is preferred.

About the Benefits
•	Permanent, full time role with established industry leader
•	Annual salary: $150,000 - $180,000 (depending on experience) + super.
•	Flexible work arrangements, with 2 days per week WFH
•	Generous discounts on our extensive range of products
•	Ability to schedule leave every year over the Christmas period.
•	Additional paid day’s leave on your birthday
•	Flare benefits program - salary packaging, discounts and premium perks
•	Employee Assistance Program access
•	Career progression opportunities as part of a 4,500-employee organisation
